title: Pdfalyzer: pypdf has possible long runtimes/large memory usage for encrypted PDF files (CVE-2026-119208)
description: CVE-2026-119208 is a vulnerability in pypdf (pdfalyzer) that allows an attacker to craft an encrypted PDF file with a manipulated /Count value, causing excessive runtimes and large memory usage when accessing the page count. This can lead to denial of service conditions due to resource exhaustion. The issue affects versions starting from 1.16.1 and has been fixed in pypdf version 6.21.3.
